description: This PHP source file defines the class TrackerQueriesDatabaseStore, which implements data storage and update logic for tracker query metrics within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for flushing data to the database, either updating existing records or inserting new ones, based on monitor object state.

classes.name: TrackerQueriesDatabaseStore
classes.description: Implements storage operations for tracker query metrics, including flushing data to the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Updates or inserts tracker query metrics into the database based on the monitor's run count and metrics.
